Elon built this in Grok and his entire caption was four letters
The 16-second Grok video that earned 41,000 likes on zero context
caption:
Elon posted this Grok AI-generated video with a one-word title: Bamf. That is the sound Nightcrawler makes when he teleports in X-Men comics.

No camera, no crew. A prompt went in, a 16-second clip came out. The only context Elon gave was four letters.

It got 4 million views anyway.
